answer: Register with Disability Support Services (DSS) as soon as possible; the passages do not give the registration form or contact details. For Malaysia, you must provide a report from an independent qualified health professional who has experience in the relevant field.

points.text: Register early, because the assessment process can take some time.
points.quote: The assessment process can take some time, so it’s a good idea to register as early as possible.
points.title: Alternative assessment arrangements

points.text: For the Malaysian campus, the supporting report must come from an independent qualified health professional, such as a Psychiatrist, General Practitioner, Physiotherapist, Educational Psychologist or Audiologist.
points.quote: be from an independent qualified health professional who has experience in the relevant field
points.title: Register with Disability Services

points.text: For the Malaysian campus, the report should clearly state the condition, its impacts on your academic life, and recommendations for accommodations.
points.quote: clearly state the condition, its impacts on your academic life, and recommendations for accommodations to address these impacts.
points.title: Register with Disability Services

points.text: For the Malaysian campus, a DSS adviser will contact you to discuss the adjustments you may need, and you will get an email confirmation if you are eligible.
points.quote: A DSS adviser will get in touch with you to talk about any adjustments you may need for your learning.
